readerCopy.body: The next move can become obvious once forward movement has something concrete to do today. When Mars trines the North Node, initiative and direction reinforce each other, giving useful momentum to a decision that has spent too long as an idea. A first action can move the situation out of speculation and into consequence. Momentum helps leave the starting point; it does not make every available direction equally worth following.
